# Official RBI regression workbooks

Read-only copies of the user-supplied official releases, retained to test the
approved exact values and source cells independently of future production updates.
Inflation contains the May 2026 survey; consumer files contain July 2026.
The test filenames carry no release or geography-selection authority: the consumer
reader validates identity from published RBI notes inside each file.

Sources: RBI Inflation Expectations Survey of Households — Bi-monthly
(https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BimonthlyPublications.aspx?head=Inflation%20Expectations%20Survey%20of%20Households%20-%20Bi-monthly)
and the existing RBI Data Releases source (https://statistics.rbi.org.in/).
Only tests consult these copies; production always reads its canonical manual folders.
